verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents its own report suite for pulling account data out: balance, financial actions, payouts, settlement breakdown and settlement statement reports, plus retrievable fraud reports. This amounts to first-party export of financial records, but the evidence never states the file formats, never describes a complete account-data export, and never covers migrating stored card or payment data to another provider. Missing for 10: documented export of all account data, explicit open formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), card-data or token portability for leaving, offboarding documentation, independent corroboration.
